snippet.title: Windblown - Anniversary Update | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
The world of Windblown expands with the Anniversary Update, available now.

Discover two vast new biomes, master twelve new weapons, and face off against two ferocious new bosses. Dive into fresh quests, an evolving storyline, and deeper metaprogression that rewards every run. The fight for survival and freedom in the skies has never been more intense.

Windblown’s Anniversary Update is live now on PC.
